experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time before crowds build. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay at a Disney on-site hotel like Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort — both are within walking distance or a short monorail ride to Magic Kingdom, eliminating transit time and letting you return for afternoon naps before evening fireworks.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural and culinary journey through 11 countries including Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco. Sample authentic dishes, watch live cultural performances, and browse artisan crafts. This is ideal for families who want entertainment and education combined. Stay at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort — both are within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving significant travel time each day.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the fully realized world of Star Wars at Galaxy's Edge, where you can pilot the Millennium Falcon, build a custom lightsaber, and encounter stormtroopers. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror. Book Lightning Lane passes in advance for top attractions. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected to Hollywood Studios via the Disney Skyliner gondola system — a fun, fast, and free transit option that kids love.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse Disney merchandise and unique shops. This is a perfect low-cost activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket. It's a great way to ease into the Disney experience without wasting a full park day.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom, featuring the breathtaking Pandora – The World of Avatar with the Flight of Passage ride, a thrilling safari through Kilimanjaro Safaris, and live shows like Festival of the Lion King. This park is best experienced starting at morning rope drop when animals are most active. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site stays with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping your family close to the action throughout the week.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and schedule for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the hotel vending machines or a nearby 24-hour Walgreens/Walmart on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy for snacks and supplies (~$10-15)

day_by_day.notes: Stop at a nearby Walmart Supercenter (5 min drive on W Irlo Bronson) to stock up on breakfast items, snacks, and water bottles for the week — this will save significant money on park food. Budget tip: Buy a refillable water bottle; Disney allows outside food and non-alcoholic beverages.

day_by_day.morning: Take the FREE hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom (confirm shuttle schedule at front desk the night before — typically departs 8:00–9:00 AM). Arrive early for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion using Lightning Lane if budget allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland — ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Individual Lightning Lane if desired, ~$7-15), Peter Pan's Flight, and It's a Small World. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check app for times, usually early afternoon). Take a mid-afternoon break in the shade near Liberty Square to rest and rehydrate.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Main Street Electrical Parade or Mickey's Magical Friendship Faire stage show. Stay for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular (check app for exact time, usually 9:00 PM). Take the hotel shuttle back — confirm last shuttle time with hotel. Aim to leave park by 9:45–10:00 PM.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel or bring granola bars/fruit from your Walmart haul to save money before entering the park
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with fish and chips, clam chowder, and sandwiches (~$12-16 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable counter-service spots with burgers, chicken, and salads (~$13-17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Bring a poncho; afternoon thunderstorms are common. Stay hydrated with free water cups available at any quick-service location. Purchase park tickets in advance online to avoid gate price surcharges.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (confirm departure time). Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane — join virtual queue at exactly 7:00 AM on the My Disney Experience app). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for a milder experience).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase starting at 11:00 AM when it opens. Walk the 1.2-mile loop around World Showcase Lagoon visiting pavilions from Mexico, Norway (ride Frozen Ever After!), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Enjoy cultural entertainment and street performers. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Watch EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check app for time, usually 9:00 PM). Find a spot along the lagoon 30-45 minutes early for a good view. Take hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast from Walmart supplies (cereal, fruit, yogurt) to save money
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best budget counter-service options with sandwiches, Asian noodles, and rotisserie chicken (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Yorkshire County Fish Shop in the UK Pavilion — affordable fish and chips (~$10-13) or grab food from multiple World Showcase kiosks for a fun international tasting experience (~$5-8 per item)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — comfortable shoes are essential. The International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June — check Disney's website. Free water is available at any quick-service location. The Guardians virtual queue is highly competitive — set an alarm for 7:00 AM sharp.

day_by_day.morning: Take hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Rush immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Rise of the Resistance first (join boarding group via app at park open if still using virtual queue, or use Lightning Lane). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Head to Toy Story Land next — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of the park — ride Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror (two of Disney's best thrill rides). Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check app for show times). Catch Muppet*Vision 3D for a fun, air-conditioned break.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show (check app for times — usually 8:30 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45-60 minutes early for good seating in the amphitheater. Explore Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at night for a magical atmosphere. Take hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast from supplies
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun theming with affordable toasted sandwiches, BBQ brisket melts, and lunch box tarts (~$10-14 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — one of Hollywood Studios' most budget-friendly counter-service restaurants with burgers, wraps, and international dishes (~$12-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios tends to have the longest waits in the Disney park system — prioritize Rise of the Resistance and Slinky Dog Dash early. Consider purchasing Genie+ (~$25-35/day) if budget allows to maximize ride count. Bring a portable phone charger — heavy app usage drains batteries quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Take hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens early). Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first (longest waits in all of Disney World — go immediately at rope drop). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a more relaxed experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in morning or late afternoon for active animals). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Head to Asia — ride Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — plan accordingly). Watch Finding Nemo: The Big Blue… and Beyond! show in the air-conditioned theater.
day_by_day.evening: Return to hotel by 5:00–6:00 PM for a rest and pool time at the Ramada. Relax, recharge, and do laundry if needed. Explore the W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy strip for budget dining options nearby.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast or grab something quick before the shuttle
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Animal Kingdom's best counter-service spots with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken (~$13-17 per person). Eat at the outdoor waterfront seating area.
meals.dinner: Denny's or IHOP on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (~$10-15 per person) — several budget chain restaurants within 1-2 miles of the hotel, walkable or short rideshare

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning — animals are more active and heat is less intense. Kali River Rapids will soak you — bring a change of clothes or wear quick-dry clothing. The park typically closes earlier than other parks (~6:00–8:00 PM), so plan accordingly. Rivers of Light nighttime show may be available — check the app.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Take a dip in the hotel pool. Rest your feet after four consecutive park days — this is essential for maintaining energy. Pack a light bag and head to Disney Springs via the free hotel shuttle (confirm Disney Springs shuttle availability) or a short rideshare (~$10-15).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Disney Springs — it's FREE to enter! Browse the massive World of Disney store, LEGO Store, and unique shops. Visit the Disney Springs Marketplace for character merchandise at slightly lower prices than in-park. Check out the outdoor entertainment, street performers, and the Aerophile hot air balloon ride (optional, ~$25/person). Visit the Disney Springs AMC Theater if you want air-conditioned downtime.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs and explore the entertainment district as it comes alive at night. Return to hotel via shuttle or rideshare. Pack bags and prepare for any final park day or departure activities.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast — use remaining Walmart supplies
meals.lunch: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs by Guy Fieri — affordable chicken tenders with 22 dipping sauces (~$12-15 per person) or grab food from the outdoor marketplace vendors
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe for a splurge dinner (~$20-30 per person) OR save money at Earl of Sandwich (~$8-12 per person) — one of the best budget dining values at Disney Springs with fresh-baked bread sandwiches

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is a great free activity — no park ticket required. It's an excellent opportunity to buy any last-minute souvenirs, as prices are comparable to in-park stores. The area gets very crowded on Saturday evenings — arrive for dinner before 6:00 PM to avoid long waits. Free parking is available in the garages if you have a rental car.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-21 (Sunday - Final Park Day or Departure Prep)
day_by_day.morning: Use this day as a flex day — revisit your favorite park for any missed rides or experiences, OR if your return flight is in the afternoon/evening, spend the morning at the hotel pool and check out. If visiting a park, take the hotel shuttle one final time to your chosen park (Magic Kingdom recommended for a farewell visit). Use the My Disney Experience app to grab any remaining Lightning Lane passes for must-do rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: If departing: Check out of the Ramada by Wyndham (standard checkout is 11:00 AM — request late checkout if needed). Store luggage at the front desk if your flight is later. Take a final stroll around the hotel area or relax at the pool. Head to Orlando International Airport via rideshare (Uber/Lyft ~$25-35, allow 45-60 minutes for travel + security). If staying for a full park day: Enjoy your final afternoon at the chosen park, grab any last souvenirs, and soak in the magic.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando with magical memories! If flight is evening, grab dinner at the airport — check out Landshark Bar & Grill or Chili's To Go in the terminal for a sit-down meal, or grab a quick bite at a food court (~$12-18 per person).

meals.breakfast: Finish remaining hotel room food supplies or grab a quick continental breakfast if offered by the hotel
meals.lunch: If in a park: Casey's Corner at Magic Kingdom for hot dogs and corn dog nuggets (~$10-13) — a classic, affordable Magic Kingdom staple. If at hotel/departing: Subway or McDonald's on W Irlo Bronson Hwy (~$8-12)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-park counter service for a final Disney meal — set a budget of ~$15-20 per person for a satisfying farewell dinner

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tips for the week: Buy park tickets in advance online (save 10-15% vs gate prices). Use the free hotel shuttle daily to eliminate transportation costs. Bring snacks and refillable water bottles into parks. Eat one meal per day outside the parks. Skip Genie+ on slower park days. Total estimated daily budget per person (excluding park tickets): $40-60/day for food and incidentals. Park tickets: ~$109-189/day depending on date and park — check Disney's official site for exact pricing and consider a multi-day ticket for significant savings.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take the Magical Express or a rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and get settled. Grab a light snack from the hotel vending area or a nearby 24-hour convenience store. Review park tickets, download the My Disney Experience app, and plan the week ahead. Get a good night's rest.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light snack at the hotel upon arrival – vending machine, hotel grab-and-go, or a quick stop at a nearby 7-Eleven or Walgreens on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is late at night. Do not schedule any theme park activities. Focus on a smooth check-in. Confirm the hotel's free theme park shuttle schedule for the next morning. Set an early alarm for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle departing around 7:45–8:00 AM. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if available) and Peter Pan's Flight. Grab a Mickey-shaped pretzel from a cart as a mid-morning snack.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise. After lunch, head to Liberty Square for the Haunted Mansion. Take a mid-afternoon break in the shade near Cinderella Castle and watch a daytime cavalcade or character meet-and-greet. Use this time to recharge before the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular – 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show (typically at park close, ~9:00–10:00 PM). Find a spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 30–45 minutes early. Ride any remaining favorites with shorter evening wait times. Return to hotel via the free shuttle after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at the hotel or grab a granola bar/fruit before boarding the shuttle
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – mid-range quick service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. – table-service American classics like burgers and sandwiches in a charming Victorian setting (~$20–$35 per person); make an advance dining reservation via My Disney Experience

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for Magic Kingdom to minimize wait times on peak summer days. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and a small fan or cooling towel – June in Orlando is hot and humid. The hotel shuttle may have limited return times; confirm the last shuttle departure.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT, arriving at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Start in Future World (now World Discovery and World Nature) and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early. Then transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Begin your cultural journey at the Mexico Pavilion and work your way around the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the World Showcase loop – stop at Norway (ride Frozen Ever After), Germany, Italy, Japan, and France. Sample small bites and snacks from each country's food kiosks and quick-service spots. Visit the Canada and UK pavilions. Catch a live cultural performance or street entertainment along the promenade. Take a relaxing boat ride on the World Showcase Lagoon if available.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime lagoon spectacular (check current show schedule). Watch from the World Showcase promenade near the America pavilion for the best views. After the show, browse the international gift shops before heading back to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from the hotel or a quick bite at EPCOT's Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion (~$12–$18)
meals.lunch: Snack your way through the World Showcase – try a School Bread from Norway (~$6), a crepe from France (~$8), and a taco from Mexico (~$10). Budget ~$25–$30 total for a 'snack lunch'
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion – hibachi-style table-service dinner with entertaining chefs (~$30–$45 per person); book an advance dining reservation

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best enjoyed at a leisurely pace – don't rush the World Showcase. The Food & Culture experience is enhanced by trying at least 4–5 different country offerings. If traveling with young children, the Norway and Mexico pavilions are especially engaging. Check the EPCOT app for live entertainment schedules.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Book a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). Then visit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and explore the land – interact with droids, browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities, and build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (advance reservation required, ~$250 per lightsaber – optional splurge).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios. Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land. Visit the Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular or a live show. Take a mid-afternoon break with a cold treat from Woody's Lunch Box.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check showtimes – typically two shows on busy summer nights). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seats. After the show, do a final walk through Galaxy's Edge at night – the atmosphere is magical after dark. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed quick-service breakfast with items like Ronto Morning Wraps (~$14–$16)
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land – affordable quick-service with grilled cheese sandwiches and totchos (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – unique table-service experience where you dine in retro cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips (~$20–$35 per person); advance dining reservation recommended

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building (~$250) and Droid Depot (~$120) are premium experiences – plan budget accordingly if interested. Rise of the Resistance is the must-do attraction; secure a Lightning Lane Individual Attraction purchase at 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Fantasmic! dining packages are available if you want guaranteed seating.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience – Take the hotel shuttle for rope drop (~8:00 AM). Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first (the most popular ride in the park – waits can exceed 2 hours by mid-morning). Then experience Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora and take photos of the floating mountains.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom. Visit Africa for Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active – try to squeeze in a second ride). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you will get wet – plan accordingly). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show – one of Disney's best stage productions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the 'Rivers of Light' nighttime spectacular or 'Tree of Life Awakenings' (check current show schedule). The Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal imagery after dark – a beautiful and peaceful experience. Enjoy a final stroll through Discovery Island before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or eat at Flame Tree Barbecue near the park entrance upon arrival (~$14–$18)
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – the best quick-service restaurant in Animal Kingdom with healthy grain bowls and unique Avatar-themed dishes (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – table-service pan-Asian cuisine with dishes like Mandarin chicken and dim sum (~$20–$35 per person); advance dining reservation recommended

day_by_day.notes: Bring a change of clothes or a poncho for Kali River Rapids. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8:00–9:00 PM in summer). Flight of Passage is the #1 priority – use Lightning Lane if boarding group is unavailable. The park is very walkable but large; wear your most comfortable shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and Recovery Morning – Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Spend the morning at the hotel pool, which is a great way to cool off mid-trip. Alternatively, use this time to revisit a favorite park for a half-day or explore the Kissimmee area. Consider a visit to Old Town Kissimmee (free admission) just a short drive away for a nostalgic Americana experience with shops and rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment – Take the hotel shuttle or a rideshare to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Browse unique shops like World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and Uniqlo. Catch a live street performance or musician. Visit the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for complimentary beverage samples with great views.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a full Disney Springs evening experience. Watch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or catch a live show. Browse the entertainment options and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere along the waterfront. This is a relaxed, no-rush evening before your final full park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a nearby IHOP/Denny's on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a casual setting (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare (~$30–$50 per person); advance dining reservation strongly recommended for Saturday evenings

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great budget-friendly option for a day with no park ticket cost. Parking is free in the Disney Springs garages. Saturday evenings are very busy – arrive at The BOATHOUSE early or book a reservation well in advance. This day serves as a mid-trip reset before the final park day.

day_by_day.morning: Favorite Park Revisit or EPCOT/Magic Kingdom Half-Day – Use this final full day to revisit your favorite park or catch any rides you missed. Magic Kingdom is recommended for a final morning as it offers the most classic Disney magic. Arrive at rope drop and prioritize any remaining bucket-list attractions. Alternatively, return to EPCOT for any World Showcase pavilions you didn't fully explore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue your park visit through the afternoon. Use any remaining Lightning Lane credits. Take time to browse merchandise and pick up souvenirs. Enjoy a final character meet-and-greet or photo opportunity in front of Cinderella Castle. If you've done all four parks, consider a relaxing afternoon back at the hotel pool or a final visit to Disney Springs for last-minute shopping.
day_by_day.evening: Final Disney Evening Celebration – Return to Magic Kingdom for one last evening and stay for the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks finale. Alternatively, enjoy a farewell dinner at Disney Springs. Take a final stroll down Main Street U.S.A. and soak in the magic. Return to the hotel, pack your bags, and prepare for departure. Confirm your checkout time and transportation arrangements for the next morning.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Magic Kingdom (breakfast or lunch service) – dine inside the Beast's enchanted castle with French-inspired cuisine (~$15–$25 per person); advance reservation required
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. – classic American hot dogs and corn dog nuggets at an affordable price (~$10–$14 per person)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort – character dining with Mickey and friends, buffet-style American comfort food (~$55–$65 per adult, ~$35–$40 per child); a splurge-worthy final night experience with advance reservation

day_by_day.notes: Check out of the hotel is typically 11:00 AM – confirm with the front desk if you need a late checkout. Store luggage with the hotel concierge if you plan to visit a park on your departure day. Confirm return transportation to Orlando International Airport. The hotel's free shuttle may not serve the airport – arrange a rideshare or shuttle service in advance. Leave extra time for airport security during summer travel season.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time before crowds build. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay at a Disney on-site hotel like Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort — both are within walking distance or a short monorail ride to Magic Kingdom, eliminating transit time and letting you return for afternoon naps before evening fireworks.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural and culinary journey through 11 countries including Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco. Sample authentic dishes, watch live cultural performances, and browse artisan crafts. This is ideal for families who want entertainment and education combined. Stay at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort — both are within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving significant travel time each day.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the fully realized world of Star Wars at Galaxy's Edge, where you can pilot the Millennium Falcon, build a custom lightsaber, and encounter stormtroopers. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror. Book Lightning Lane passes in advance for top attractions. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected to Hollywood Studios via the Disney Skyliner gondola system — a fun, fast, and free transit option that kids love.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse Disney merchandise and unique shops. This is a perfect low-cost activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket. It's a great way to ease into the Disney experience without wasting a full park day.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom, featuring the breathtaking Pandora – The World of Avatar with the Flight of Passage ride, a thrilling safari through Kilimanjaro Safaris, and live shows like Festival of the Lion King. This park is best experienced starting at morning rope drop when animals are most active. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site stays with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping your family close to the action throughout the week.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 22:30. Rest and prepare for the week ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Use the hotel's complimentary theme park shuttle or arrange a private car transfer to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Review the week's Disney park reservations and download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: In-flight or at the airport.
meals.dinner: Late-night arrival — grab a light bite at a 24-hour spot near the hotel such as Denny's or order room service if available. Alternatively, pick up snacks at a nearby Walgreens or Publix for the room.

day_by_day.notes: Ensure Disney park reservations are confirmed in the My Disney Experience app before sleeping. Set an early alarm for Day 2 to maximize park time. The hotel offers a free theme park shuttle — check the schedule at the front desk upon arrival. Consider purchasing Disney Genie+ in advance for Day 2 to skip standby lines.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Begin with an early morning arrival at Magic Kingdom, taking the hotel's complimentary shuttle to arrive before park opening (rope drop). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle / Run using Lightning Lane Individual selections booked in advance. Then visit Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight. Enjoy the iconic Main Street, U.S.A. atmosphere and snap photos of Cinderella Castle in the morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — experience Adventureland's Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise, then head to Liberty Square for the Haunted Mansion. Use Disney Genie+ Lightning Lane selections strategically throughout the afternoon to minimize wait times. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade along Main Street, U.S.A. for a spectacular mid-afternoon show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the crown jewel of the evening — the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (check current show schedule). Secure a premium viewing spot on Main Street, U.S.A. at least 45 minutes before showtime. Return to the hotel via the complimentary shuttle after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant — Book the prix-fixe breakfast inside the Beast's enchanted castle in Fantasyland for an immersive, premium dining experience. Reserve well in advance via My Disney Experience.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen — Skipper Canteen offers a unique, story-driven menu with globally inspired dishes in an adventurous setting, perfect for a premium lunch experience.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — Dine inside Cinderella Castle itself for a truly magical, character-dining dinner experience with princess meet-and-greets. One of Disney's most coveted reservations; book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Individual Lightning Lane selections for TRON Lightcycle / Run and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train as early as 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring sunscreen and refillable water bottles. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (highs near 92°F/33°C) with afternoon thunderstorms possible — carry a compact poncho.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT at rope drop and begin with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature). Experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane at 7:00 AM) and Test Track. Then transition into the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM, starting your cultural and culinary journey through the 11 country pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase experience — sample signature dishes and beverages from Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Don't miss the Frozen Ever After ride in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion (use Lightning Lane). Explore artisan shops and cultural exhibits in each pavilion at a leisurely, premium pace.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or the Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (verify current show schedule). Secure a waterfront viewing spot near the America pavilion for the best vantage point. Enjoy a final evening cocktail at La Cava del Tequila in the Mexico pavilion before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — a quick-service option with fresh, healthy options to fuel your morning before the World Showcase opens.
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion) — an upscale teppanyaki dining experience with skilled chefs cooking tableside. Reserve in advance.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (France Pavilion) — EPCOT's most refined dining experience, offering classic French haute cuisine with stunning lagoon views. One of Walt Disney World's signature restaurants. Reserve 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is ideal for leisurely exploration — don't rush. The park is large, so wear comfortable shoes. If traveling with children, the Kidcot Fun Stops in each country pavilion are a wonderful interactive activity. Check the EPCOT entertainment schedule for live cultural performances throughout the day in each pavilion.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Take the hotel shuttle for an early rope-drop arrival. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge and secure a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of the most technologically advanced theme park attractions ever built. Then pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run. Explore the immersive land, interact with droids and stormtroopers, and build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (book in advance — $250 per lightsaber).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios — experience Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash via Lightning Lane), The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular or Muppet*Vision 3D for a mid-afternoon break from the heat. Visit the Animation Courtyard for Disney Junior and Star Wars Launch Bay.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check current schedule and arrive 45–60 minutes early for premium seating). The show features Mickey Mouse, beloved Disney characters, and stunning water, fire, and projection effects. Return to the hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick, premium breakfast at The Trolley Car Café (Starbucks) on Hollywood Boulevard or pre-order a mobile order from Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land.
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — a uniquely themed, air-conditioned restaurant where guests dine in vintage cars while watching classic sci-fi movie clips. A beloved Hollywood Studios institution. Reserve in advance.
meals.dinner: Oga's Cantina (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge) for pre-dinner cocktails and the full Galaxy's Edge atmosphere, followed by dinner at The Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' most upscale dining venue, inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood restaurant, serving classic American cuisine with a modern twist.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building experience is $259.99 per lightsaber and must be reserved in advance — a truly premium, once-in-a-lifetime Star Wars experience. Droid Depot (build your own droid) is another premium add-on at approximately $119.99. June afternoons bring thunderstorms — outdoor attractions may temporarily close, so plan indoor experiences for 2:00–4:00 PM.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience — Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular attraction — book Individual Lightning Lane at 7:00 AM) for a breathtaking banshee-riding simulation over the alien moon of Pandora. Then experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — embark on Kilimanjaro Safaris for an authentic African savanna experience with live animals including elephants, giraffes, lions, and rhinos. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Experience Expedition Everest in Asia and DINOSAUR in DinoLand U.S.A. Catch the Festival of the Lion King live show — a world-class theatrical performance.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (verify current show schedule) or enjoy the magical transformation of Pandora at night, when the bioluminescent plants glow brilliantly after dark — an absolutely stunning visual experience. Return to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel or a quick stop at Starbucks near the park entrance to fuel up before rope drop.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's most upscale and critically acclaimed dining experience, inspired by the travels of Disney's Imagineers. Features globally inspired cuisine with stunning artwork and an elegant atmosphere. Reserve 60 days in advance.
meals.dinner: Nomad Lounge (adjacent to Tiffins) for craft cocktails and small plates as a relaxed early evening experience, then head to Disney Springs for dinner at STK Orlando — a modern steakhouse with a vibrant atmosphere, premium cuts, and an extensive wine list.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. The park can feel more relaxed than Magic Kingdom or Hollywood Studios. Pandora at night is a must-see — plan to stay until after dark if possible. The complimentary hotel shuttle schedule should be checked for late-night return options.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Day — Begin with a leisurely late morning at the hotel, enjoying a relaxed breakfast before heading to Disney Springs. Explore The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side districts at a premium, unhurried pace. Visit the World of Disney store, LEGO Store, and browse luxury boutiques. Book a behind-the-scenes experience or a cooking class at The BOATHOUSE or Paddlefish if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Disney Springs — visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for premium bowling and billiards, or catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater. Browse art galleries and enjoy live entertainment from street performers and musicians throughout the open-air complex. Consider a relaxing spa afternoon at a nearby luxury spa (Grand Floridian Spa or Senses Spa at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort, accessible via Disney transportation).
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening at Disney Springs for world-class dining and entertainment. Enjoy live music at Raglan Road Irish Pub or House of Blues. Take a leisurely stroll along the waterfront as the complex lights up beautifully at night. This is also an ideal evening for souvenir shopping and picking up premium Disney merchandise.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the hotel or a nearby premium café — consider First Watch or a hotel restaurant for a relaxed start.
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE — a nautical-themed, upscale waterfront restaurant at Disney Springs featuring premium steaks, chops, and fresh seafood. Known for its amphicar tours on the water. Reserve in advance.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Disney Springs restaurant offering Pan-Asian cuisine in a stunning, dramatic setting. Features sushi, dim sum, and signature dishes. One of Disney Springs' most celebrated dining experiences. Reserve well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and offers free parking in its multi-level garages. This day serves as a wonderful recovery day from the intensity of the theme parks. The Amphicar tours at The BOATHOUSE are a unique, premium experience ($125 per vehicle for a 20-minute tour) — book upon arrival as they fill quickly. Consider scheduling a spa treatment in the afternoon for ultimate luxury relaxation.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a final half-day — choose whichever park you'd like to revisit or experience attractions you missed earlier in the week. If returning to Magic Kingdom, focus on any remaining bucket-list rides. If choosing EPCOT, revisit favorite World Showcase pavilions and pick up any last-minute artisan souvenirs. Alternatively, spend the morning at the hotel pool for a relaxing final morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin the checkout process and pack luggage. Store bags with the hotel concierge if your flight departs later in the day. Take one final stroll through Disney Springs or the hotel area for any last-minute shopping. Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport — consider a private car service for a premium, stress-free departure experience.
day_by_day.evening: Depart for Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in, security, and boarding. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport's premium dining options such as Vino Volo wine bar or a sit-down restaurant in the terminal. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic.

meals.breakfast: Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort (accessible via Disney's complimentary monorail from Magic Kingdom) — a beloved character dining breakfast with Mickey Mouse and friends in a fun, festive atmosphere. Reserve 60 days in advance.
meals.lunch: Quick-service lunch at whichever park or area you're visiting — consider Columbia Harbour House (Magic Kingdom) or Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT) for a lighter, quality meal before travel.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport or an early dinner near the hotel before departure — consider Longhorn Steakhouse or a local Florida seafood restaurant near Kissimmee for a final taste of Florida cuisine.

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange late checkout if needed for an additional fee. Confirm return flight details and arrange airport transportation in advance. The hotel's complimentary shuttle may not service the airport — verify with the front desk and book a private car or rideshare (Uber/Lyft) as needed. Tip: purchase any remaining Disney souvenirs at Disney Springs or the airport Disney store to avoid carrying them through the parks all week.
